engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row182 Wistron-GPU RAS-00468-V003: approve platform/UBB/BMC/host and device0 UUID/OAM/BDF plus block1=SDMA mapping; provide amdgpuras/cdump_analyzer versions/hashes/licenses and selector0/type4 semantics, canonical secure Systems/UBB Dump endpoint with auth/CA, CPER attribution and exact OAM/SDMA/ext59/GFX_IP_Fatal_Error/fatal decoder schema, plus dedicated-workload and GPU/BMC/host OOB no-retry recovery.

review_improvement: Makes SDMA-specific bank and ext59 decoding the acceptance core, corrects the unusable endpoint suggestion and prevents coincidental CPER creation or unmapped numeric targets from satisfying the test.
independent_technical_reasoning: Block1 and selector0 direct the tool into the SDMA error source, while ext59/GFX_IP_Fatal_Error is the downstream CPER signature distinguishing it from UMC parity. Therefore command success and a new numeric entry are necessary but not sufficient: topology, event timestamp, attachment hash and decoded fields must form one provenance chain. One fatal stimulus is enough; a retry can create extra Dump entries and disrupt DMA state, defeating attribution.
